lei_13_935_psicologia_nas_f6dc6: Law 13,935: psychology in public schools | Espaço Prelúdio
conheca_o_escopo_da_lei_1dc05: Learn the scope of Law 13,935/2019 and the points administrators need to consider when planning psychology and social work in public basic education.
a_lei_13_935_2019_8a302: Law 13,935/2019 addresses psychology and social work services in public basic education systems, delivered through multidisciplinary teams. The work must respond to the needs and priorities of education policies, involve the school community, and take into account the pedagogical political project of the school system and its institutions.
para_o_gestor_o_ponto_eafb5: For administrators, the starting point is to understand the needs of the school system and the work of existing teams. The organization should include institutional action, relationships within the school community, and coordination among education, health, and protection services. The law is not limited to offering individual appointments.
um_programa_remoto_pode_compor_0dac4: A remote program can be part of access to individual care and the referral pathways defined by the school system. This contribution must have an explicit scope, responsibilities, and limits. Contracting a telepsychology platform alone does not mean that all obligations under Law 13,935 have been met, including those related to social work and multidisciplinary work.
quais_unidades_e_estudantes_serao_5f4a9: Which units and students will be covered? How does the program fit with the pedagogical political project? Who is part of the multidisciplinary team? How do consent, confidentiality, and referral work? Which indicators can management track? These decisions help define the scope and evaluate proposals using clear criteria.
consulte_o_texto_oficial_da_cbe21: See the official text of Law 13,935/2019, available on the Legislation Portal. The content of this page presents the scope of the law and planning considerations; implementation requires a technical and legal assessment by the school system for its own context.
